new=old.replace(OLDLINE,NEWLINE)+LIC
for d in (S+'local/',P):
  open(d+'README.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write(new)
hashes={d+f:H(d+f) for d in (S+'local/',P) for f in ('README.md','diagnose.py','example-case.json')}
checks={}

checks['example_unchanged_9b82f1e4']=hashes[S+'local/example-case.json']=='9b82f1e4721d5081336cba4918584eb2a6aa1d8d4d21c689d554e92c2548346f'==hashes[P+'example-case.json']

links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href=\"(local/[^\"]+)\"',idx)))
checks['index_local_links_resolve']=bool(links) and all(os.path.isfile(S+l) for l in links)
# clean-dir run
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();
for f in ('diagnose.py','example-case.json'): shutil.copy(S+'local/'+f,t)
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','diagnose.py','example-case.json','report.json'],cwd=t,capture_output=True,text=True)
rep=json.load(open(t+'/report.json'))

r2=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','diagnose.py'],cwd=t,capture_output=True,text=True)
